# EarthWorks Site Autonomy Study

Capability ID: earthworks-site-autonomy-study-v1
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: human_handoff_only
Public URL: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/capabilities/earthworks-site-autonomy-study-v1
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- reduce haul truck queueing at a quarry
- reduce loader idle time waiting on trucks
- optimize load haul dump operations
- simulate an earthmoving fleet before automation
- coordinate excavators haul trucks loaders and dozers
- find the bottleneck in aggregate material flow
- site autonomy study for a quarry
- digital twin for earthmoving operations
- shadow dispatch for haul trucks
- what part of my dirt operation should I automate
- vendor neutral heavy equipment autonomy orchestration
- increase tons per hour through fleet coordination
- study autonomous haulage without replacing equipment
- automation study for landfill bulk material or civil earthwork

## Problem

A quarry, aggregate, civil-earthwork, landfill or bulk-material operator needs to know where machine coordination, queueing, idle time, route behavior or bounded autonomy could improve a real material-flow loop before buying autonomous equipment or giving software physical control.

## Inputs

One explicitly approved site and one bounded material-flow loop; machine roster; loading/dump zones; route or zone graph; available cycle/queue/idle observations; production objective; known operating constraints and telemetry availability.

## Outputs

Receipt-backed site baseline; route/zone graph; queue/idle/cycle analysis; digital-twin replay; modeled dispatch and failure scenarios; bottleneck finding; autonomy-candidate ranking; telemetry/integration gaps; operating-domain blockers; and a go, instrument-first or no-go next-step disposition.

## Pricing

$5,000 one-time for the first three approved founding design-partner studies; planned standard price $7,500.

- Founding Design-Partner Site Autonomy Study: $5,000 (one_time)

- Site Autonomy Study: $7,500 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

PUBLIC DISCOVERY + HUMAN HANDOFF READY: software proof, study method, design-partner offer and operator-facing sample exist. No full-size physical deployment, customer result or machine-actuation authority is claimed.

AI assistants may explain the study, screen fit and prepare a human handoff. They may not create a payment obligation, claim a partnership, authorize site access, control equipment or start physical autonomy. Buyer-specific scope and explicit purchase confirmation are required before Evercraft Payments creates the canonical order.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments is canonical. Raven Nexus mediates the Stripe settlement adapter. A buyer-specific Evercraft Payment Order may be created only after explicit purchase intent for an approved study scope. Checkout creation is not payment proof; paid state requires authoritative settlement verification.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
